title: The Big Boss’s Little Wife
author: Lan Ya Lan
synopsis:
My cousin is a firm believer in remaining single. To get some peace and quiet, she begged Ling Ting to go on a blind date for her. Ling Ting went; although she thought the date was handsome and gentlemanly, she didn't give it much thought.
But what’s up with this new boss, who has a friendly smile and took the initiative to greet her?
He’s her blind date!
Ji Zhengyao: "Little comrade, we meet again."
Ling Ting: "...Hello, Boss."
